introduction: ERC-6551 defines a system for creating smart contract accounts that are bound to individual NFTs (ERC-721 tokens). Each NFT can have its own token-bound account (TBA) deployed via a permissionless registry using CREATE2. The TBA's address is deterministically derived from the NFT's chain ID, contract address, and token ID. Whoever owns the NFT automatically controls its bound account, enabling NFTs to own assets, interact with protocols, and accumulate on-chain history.
designPurpose: ERC-6551 was designed to give NFTs the ability to act as autonomous on-chain entities. Before this standard, NFTs were static assets that could not hold tokens, interact with protocols, or build an on-chain identity. Token-bound accounts transform NFTs into composable, interactive agents that can own other NFTs, hold ERC-20 tokens, and participate in DeFi. Ownership control automatically transfers when the parent NFT is sold or transferred.
commonUsage: ERC-6551 is used in blockchain gaming for character inventories (a game character NFT can own its equipment as child NFTs), in NFT collections for creating on-chain profiles and identities, and in loyalty programs where an NFT accumulates rewards. It enables nested NFT ownership, on-chain reputation tied to NFTs, and composable digital identities.
fn.createAccount.desc: Deploys a new token-bound account for a specific NFT using CREATE2. The account address is deterministic based on the implementation, salt, chain ID, token contract, and token ID.
fn.createAccount.params.implementation: The address of the account implementation contract to use.
fn.createAccount.params.salt: A salt value for CREATE2 deployment, allowing multiple accounts per NFT.
fn.createAccount.params.chainId: The chain ID where the NFT exists.
fn.createAccount.params.tokenContract: The address of the ERC-721 token contract.
fn.createAccount.params.tokenId: The token ID of the NFT to bind the account to.
fn.createAccount.returns.account: The address of the newly deployed token-bound account.
fn.account.desc: Computes the deterministic address of a token-bound account without deploying it. Returns the same address that createAccount would deploy to.
fn.account.params.salt: The salt value used in the CREATE2 computation.
fn.account.params.chainId: The chain ID where the NFT exists.
fn.account.params.tokenContract: The address of the ERC-721 token contract.
fn.account.params.tokenId: The token ID of the NFT.
fn.account.returns.accountAddress: The deterministic address of the token-bound account.
fn.execute.desc: Executes a call from the token-bound account. Only the current owner of the bound NFT can call this function.
fn.execute.params.value: The ETH value to send with the call.
fn.execute.params.operation: The operation type (0 = CALL, 1 = DELEGATECALL, 2 = CREATE, 3 = CREATE2).
fn.execute.returns.result: The return data from the executed call.
sim.createUseTba.name: Create & Use Token Bound Account
sim.createUseTba.desc: Deploy a token-bound account for an NFT and use it to interact with another contract.
sim.createUseTba.step.lookup: The NFT owner verifies their ownership of the token by checking ownerOf(tokenId) on the ERC-721 contract.
sim.createUseTba.step.deploy: The owner calls createAccount on the registry. A new token-bound account is deployed at a deterministic CREATE2 address linked to the NFT.
sim.createUseTba.step.bind: The token-bound account stores its binding information: chain ID, token contract, and token ID. This links the account permanently to the NFT.
sim.createUseTba.step.execute: The NFT owner calls execute() on the TBA to interact with a target contract. The TBA verifies the caller owns the bound NFT before executing.
